hPDL1.why: the one input BCX measured; the baseline rung

hCA2.why: carbonic anhydrase II (3KS3): an alpha/beta fold rather than an all-beta one, and it carries one unresolved residue (126) so the ladder is not all perfect structures

hIL2R.why: the chain count changes, and 387 aa puts a 100 aa binder exactly at the 512 ceiling

hTNFa.why: TNF-alpha (1TNF): three chains, and a real drug target that lands just past the ceiling

hHSA.why: serum albumin (1AO6) at Sudlow site I: the largest single-chain target a researcher plausibly brings, and well past the ceiling

hPCSK9.why: PCSK9 (2P4E) at the LDLR EGF-A site: a two-chain drug target at 586 aa, and the messiest structure in the set with five gaps in the catalytic chain

hTF.why: serotransferrin (3V83 chain A) at the N-lobe iron site: at 674 aa it is the largest single-chain target here, and it is what takes the ladder past 704 tokens once the shipped path turned out to reach further than the published ceiling
